sentences.text:
The Honourable Sri Justice K.Sarath
 Writ Petition No.18278 Of 2024
Order:

This Writ petition is filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India, seeking the following relief:
"...to issue a writ order or direction more particularly one in the nature of writ of Mandamus declaring the action of the respondents Nos.4 to 8 in not paying the compensation to the petitioners by passing award in respect of land in Sy. No. 148,
338 and 339 total admeasuring Ac. 36.39 guntas situated at Komati Kondapur Village, Ibrahimpatnam Mandal, Jagitial District, in pursuation of the representation dated 03-06- 2024 and action of the respondent No.2 in not releasing the funds to pay compensation to the petitioners by considering the representation dated 18-06-2024 as illegal, arbitrary and contrary to law apart from violation of Principles of Natural Justice besides violative of Articles 14, 21 and 300-A of the Constitution of India and

consequently direct the respondent No.2 to release the funds by considering the representation dated 18-06- 2024 and respondent Nos. 4 to 8 to forthwith pay compensation to the petitioners by passing aware under the provisions of the Right to Fare Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 in respect of land in Sy. No. 148, 338 and 339 total admeasuring Ac. 36.39 guntas situated at Komati Kondapur Village,
Ibrahimpatnam Mandal, Jagitial District, till then not to dispossess the petitioners from the above said land and pass..."
2. Heard learned counsel for the petitioners, learned Government Pleader for Land Acquisition for the respondents.
3. Learned Government Pleader for Land Acquisition for the respondents submits that the respondents shall ::2::
SK, J consider the representations dated 03.06.2024 and 18.06.2024 submitted by the petitioners and shall pass appropriate orders in accordance with law.
4. In view of the submissions made by both sides, the writ petition is disposed of, directing the respondents to consider the representations dated 03.06.2024 and 18.06.2024 submitted by the petitioners and shall pass appropriate orders, within a period of eight (08) weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order. However, there shall be no order as to costs.
5. Miscellaneous petitions pending, if any, shall also stand closed.
__
